note: coverage_pct is over team-rows present in mart_fact_team_match_stats_v2 for that provider and season. An absent metric is reported absent and is never zero-filled.

backward_passes.definition: Passes played into the back zone.

big_chances_created.definition: Chances Opta classifies as clear scoring opportunities created by this side.

blocks.definition: Blocks by outfield players, excluding blocked shots on goal.

bps.definition: Team total of FPL's own bonus-point-system score. Context for the bonus model.

crosses.definition: Crosses attempted from open play and set pieces.

defensive_actions.definition: Team total of the actions FPL's defensive-contribution award counts (tackles, recoveries, and clearances/blocks/interceptions). Measured only where its inputs are -- the FPL archive carries them from 2025-26 only, and NULL before that.

expected_goals.definition: Opta expected goals for this side's shots.

expected_goals_conceded_measured.definition: Team expected goals conceded as measured by FPL's own per-player xGC (the maximum over the squad, since a player's xGC is the team's during his minutes). Deliberately NOT the same column as expected_goals_allowed, which is the opponent's expected_goals mirrored across the fixture: the two measure the same concept from different sources and are retained separately so their disagreement stays visible.

expected_goals_on_target.definition: Post-shot expected goals -- xG conditioned on shot placement, defined only over shots on target. Measures finishing and keeper workload rather than chance creation.

forward_passes.definition: Passes played into the forward zone.

goals.definition: Goals scored by this side, excluding own goals credited to the opponent.

penalty_area_entries.definition: Entries into the opposition penalty area.

possession.definition: Share of possession, 0-100. Stored as a percent, never a fraction: the two sides of a match must sum to ~100, which is the coverage report's consistency check.

possession_won_attacking_third.definition: Possession regained in the attacking third -- the high-press signal.

possession_won_defensive_third.definition: Possession regained in the defensive third -- the low-block signal.

possession_won_middle_third.definition: Possession regained in the middle third.

red_cards.definition: Red cards received, including second yellows.

saves.definition: Goalkeeper saves made by this side.

shots.definition: Total goal attempts, on and off target, including blocked.

shots_blocked.definition: This side's goal attempts blocked by an opposition outfield player.

shots_inside_box.definition: Goal attempts taken from inside the penalty area.

shots_on_target.definition: Goal attempts on target, including those saved and those scored.

shots_on_target_allowed_proxy.definition: On-target shots faced, derived as sum(saves + goals_conceded) over the club's goalkeeper appearances in the fixture. A measurement of the same quantity as shots_on_target_allowed, by a different route and with different failure modes.

shots_outside_box.definition: Goal attempts taken from outside the penalty area.

touches_in_opposition_box.definition: Touches by this side inside the opposition penalty area.
